description: Start a labelled dataset: figures (company, measure, period, value) are checked by machine against the SEC filings and written as blind CSV packets for two or more people to label, with guidelines and a key holding the machine labels.

annotators.description: Packets to write, one per person. Default 2: two people label every item independently.

assisted.description: Show the machine's label and the filed figure in the packets. Default false (blind), so agreement with the machine means something.

company.description: With text: the company the draft is about.

items.description: Figures to label: company, measure, period, value (and unit), as for verify_claims.

items_file.description: Or a JSONL file of the same objects, up to 2,000.

out_dir.description: Folder for the task folder. Default: a new temporary folder.

task.description: A name for the task, e.g. q3-revenue-check: the folder the files go in.

text.description: Or a draft about one company (an AI's answer, say): every figure in it with a measure and a period becomes an item. Needs company.

name: annotation_packet
title: Annotation packets
